quest.title: Don't Let the Colors Escape!
quest.description: You return to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, where you run into an old friend together with some rather special Ashas...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Go to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this frisky little Asha doing here? And— Huh? Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Back at the resort for a vacation, Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Uh-huh. {NICKNAME} might recall that I wrote you two a letter to let you know that...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: A few months ago, I finally saved up enough money from all my well-paying commissions...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And I finally managed to invite my dads and friends to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort for a proper getaway.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: My dads were really pleased to see that my streak of bad luck has almost fully ended at Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you definitely have to share good news like this with everyone, Bennett!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Aw, if only we met you two last week. We could all have had a meal together or something.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Hmm, looks like that meal's got to wait till you two come over to Mondstadt again. When you come, we'll find somewhere super safe and have a "Safe Adventuring Cave Dinner" together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold up, Bennett — are you saying that your dads and friends are gone and you're here at the resort by yourself now?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah. My dads were actually having a really good time here when they received news that Miss Diona at Cat's Tail Tavern would be away on a business trip for quite some time...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: So, rather than extend their vacation, they decided to return to Mondstadt as originally planned. That way, they'll be able to get in a few more of Miss Diona's special drinks before she goes on her trip.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But don't you worry, I'm not stranded here because of a delay or lost boat ticket or anything. I'm staying to help out a few friends.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: We were fishing by the sea when we ran into a few Ashas, known as "colorists," that appeared to be in some kind of tricky situation.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Based on my experience from before, I guessed they were looking for some extraordinary treasure...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. Since these Ashas are known as colorists, the treasure they were looking for must be...

choices.text: Some kind of super awesome color paint?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: That's right! Aside from painting surfaces everywhere they go, the Ashas also love to seek out color paints for their personal collections.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: The colorist Ashas have discovered a very special color paint in some secret realm... It's a kind of free-roaming paint.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: And like the Crystalfly, these colors are always moving around, all over the place. The colorists have no idea how to catch them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, tell you what, let us help too. Let's go to that place and see what's going on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows, we might already have tackled something like this before.

choices.text: It is always a pleasure to help out an Asha in need.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Great! Let's give the colorists a hand together then. I'll just follow your lead in this.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I really hope these Ashas can get hold of the most marvelous colors so they can mix the most radiant, dazzling hues and continue spreading their unique brand of joy!

choices.text: Want something special for your collection? We're the ones to call.
Some kind of really precious color paint?
It feels so good to hear it no matter how many times you say it!
